verdict.rationale: The x402 Bazaar is a published, public catalog of payment-gated services that lists more than 23,000 resources. Agents can search it by intent, with network, asset, scheme and price filters, through keyless discovery APIs, the TypeScript SDK, a generated OpenAPI client, or the Bazaar MCP server as tool calls. A runtime probe independently confirmed that a keyless GET to the discovery endpoint returned real payable-service listings, and sellers are indexed automatically after their first settled payment.
